action: unlock=$(omarchy-plymouth-switcher); if [[ $unlock == default ]]; then omarchy-launch-floating-terminal-with-presentation omarchy-plymouth-reset; elif [[ -n $unlock ]]; then omarchy-launch-floating-terminal-with-presentation "omarchy-plymouth-set-by-theme '$unlock'"; fi

unlock=$(omarchy-plymouth-switcher); if [[ $unlock == default ]]; then omarchy-launch-floating-terminal-with-presentation omarchy-plymouth-reset; elif [[ -n $unlock ]]; then omarchy-launch-floating-terminal-with-presentation "omarchy-plymouth-set-by-theme $(printf %q "$unlock")"; fi

new.description: Stop world-writable Chromium and Firefox policy directories
Require signed packages from the Omarchy repository
Skip Chromium's new first-run EULA on machines already on Quattro
Separate printer discovery from root and print-filter access
Drop the default input group grant, which allowed unprivileged keylogging
Remove privileged files left behind by retired Omarchy installers
Repair legacy XCompose and remove vulnerable Omarchy 3 power udev rules
Point rc-channel installs at the rc package repository
Disable SSH password authentication, or sshd itself when no key is authorized
